review.name: Storm Wyvern
findings: Final close-up rejected jaw-only v1 and widened binding v2. Neck-only v3 still left opposing chest/spine motion. V4 fixed recoil and defeat but independent victory close-up found another upper-throat fold. V5 includes all four identified clips: ten explicit supporting neck rotations, all other curves exact. All twelve new raw slices and 216 actual equipped technique frames inspected and pass; 203 geometry poses and 468 original independent face blends pass. Separate battle rebuild and final second pass pending.

Final second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source and battle each pass 203 full-geometry poses and 468 independent face blends. Original sculpt, UVs, textures and bone frames unchanged. Jaw-binding stage followed by ten explicit supporting neck rotations across four identified clips. Ten regression/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Whole-roster/main/live verification still pending.
